In a bookstore, there were 95 books on a shelf at the beginning of the day. If Emily removed 19 books and Olivia removed three times as many as Emily, how many books are left on the shelf by the end of the day?

Emily removed 19 books.
Olivia removed 3 × 19 = 57 books.
Total books removed = 19 + 57 = 76 books.
Books remaining = 95 - 76 = 19 books.

There are 19 books left on the shelf.
